entities.name: Sustainable Fashion Movement
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Rana Plaza factory collapse (2013, 1,134 deaths) galvanized the sustainable fashion movement. Brands now face pressure for ethical supply chains, organic materials, circular design, and living wages. "Who made my clothes?" became a global campaign.
